newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade very slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in very a limited test.

Sales confirmed on 2000 slaughter steers and 1600 slaughter heifers early Wednesday. Sales confirmed for the week to date 72,000 head, volume includes 20,300 head of previously contracted and formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 65.00-66.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 960-1150 lbs 65.00-66.00; mixed Commercial to Choice heifers and heiferettes 1150-1200 lbs 64.00. Confirmed 3,600 last week 3,300 last year 7,500
Week-to-date 72,000 last week 71,600 last year 56,500 ((Chicago newsdesk 312-408-8720))
